import fitz
import os

LIBERATION_SERIF = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf"
LIBERATION_SERIF_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSerif-Bold.ttf"
LIBERATION_SERIF_ITALIC = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSerif-Italic.ttf"

def replace_fonts_in_pdf(inpath, outpath=None):
    """Replace DejaVu fonts with Liberation Serif in a PDF."""
    if outpath is None:
        outpath = inpath
    
    doc = fitz.open(inpath)
    
    for page_num in range(len(doc)):
        page = doc[page_num]
        
        # Get all text with detailed info
        blocks = page.get_text("dict")
        
        spans_to_replace = []
        for block in blocks.get("blocks", []):
            if "lines" not in block:
                continue
            for line in block["lines"]:
                for span in line["spans"]:
                    font_name = span.get("font", "")
                    if "DejaVu" in font_name:
                        spans_to_replace.append(span)
        
        if not spans_to_replace:
            continue
        
        # For each span: add redaction, then re-insert text
        for span in spans_to_replace:
            rect = fitz.Rect(span["bbox"])
            page.add_redact_annot(rect)
        
        page.apply_redactions()
        
        # Re-insert text
        for span in spans_to_replace:
            rect = fitz.Rect(span["bbox"])
            text = span["text"]
            size = span["size"]
            color = span.get("color", 0)
            
            # Convert int color to RGB tuple
            if isinstance(color, int):
                r = ((color >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0
                g = ((color >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0
                b = (color & 0xFF) / 255.0
                color_tuple = (r, g, b)
            else:
                color_tuple = (0, 0, 0)
            
            font_name = span.get("font", "")
            if "Bold" in font_name:
                fontfile = LIBERATION_SERIF_BOLD
                fontname = "LibSer-B"
            elif "Oblique" in font_name or "Italic" in font_name:
                fontfile = LIBERATION_SERIF_ITALIC
                fontname = "LibSer-I"
            else:
                fontfile = LIBERATION_SERIF
                fontname = "LibSer"
            
            # Insert text at the same position
            tw = fitz.TextWriter(page.rect)
            font = fitz.Font(fontname, fontfile)
            tw.append(fitz.Point(rect.x0, rect.y1 - size * 0.15), text, font=font, fontsize=size)
            tw.write_text(page, color=color_tuple)
    
    doc.save(outpath)
    doc.close()
    return True
